fold_policy: Same capture family stays in one fold. S28 placement/target pairs fit; S06 contact validation; S19/S22 outline results test. One test pair only. Same rig/physical marks recur across captures; no independent-view robustness claim.
release_requirements: Miguel independently reviews every member of every pair
Exactly one visually supported PASS and one FAIL per pair; unresolved/UNKNOWN/rejected pair blocks whole-set scoring
Each pair must be image-dependent and not answerable from manual text alone
Footprint target is explicitly approved as image-space only, or pair is rejected/replaced
Source/image/target hashes and frozen folds remain unchanged; no label/state metadata in model prompts
excluded_text_questions: Must paper be positioned correctly before drawing?
Should the pen touch the paper?
Does a lock prevent concurrent jobs?
physical_boundary: No result accepts robot registration, paper-to-robot coordinates, contact force, calibration or green instructions. /assist stays default-deny; archived frames are not live evidence.
